use_case_summary: Primary workloads: customer-facing chat (low-latency, per-message audit logs), document search (embeddings stored in-house), and reranking of transactions for fraud scoring. Latency target: p99 <= 120ms for chat sessions at 90 concurrent agents; throughput for embeddings: 50 req/s. Cost sensitive but will prioritize reliability and auditability for production flows.
networking_requirements: AWS PrivateLink endpoints to host private control plane (no public EIP) - prefer interface endpoints over internet-facing load balancers
Option B: VPC peering for high-throughput internal-only traffic (if cross-account peering approved)
Strict firewall rules: only specific port ranges allowed, egress whitelist to internal proxies and S3 VPC endpoints
Egress controls: all outbound traffic must traverse corporate egress proxies; explicit deny of unknown external destinations
IP allowlists: static set required for initial rollout, plus a documented change window (48-72h) for updates
Support for centralized route-table-based NAT or private NAT gateways depending on instance placement
TLS mutual auth for control plane + client certificates for host-level authentication
DNS controls: use of private hosted zones, no public DNS leakage
